title: Questions 147-148 refer to the following advertisement.
passage_1:
Willow Bend Craft Brewing Fair

Prepare your senses for three days of remarkable aromas at the 7th Annual Willow Bend Craft Brewing Fair in Ardmore Commons from September 12 to 14. This season, we are concentrating on low-waste brewing methods, highlighting grain and hops supplied entirely by regional growers. Guests are welcome to taste beverages from more than 40 separate brewers and watch live blending workshops led by award-winning brewmasters.

Please note that personal coolers and outside drinks are prohibited within the fair grounds. While admission to the open tasting hall is free of charge, passes for the limited Brewer’s Bench tasting experience must be reserved ahead of time on our Web site.
